context.transcript:
Hello and good morning.
It's great to see so many people here at the Overlook Community Center for our weekly health and wellness program.
We have a treat for you today.
Our special guest presenter is Susanna Adachi, a yoga and meditation expert.
You may not be familiar with her work, but she has won multiple awards.
Ms. Adachi is excited to share with you her knowledge and insights about how yoga can improve your life.
Now, as we prepare to begin the program, please roll out your yoga mats in front of you.
context.transcript_translation:
早上好，大家早上好。
很高兴看到这么多人在 Overlook Community Center 参加我们每周的健康与养生项目。
今天我们为大家准备了特别环节。
我们的特邀演讲嘉宾是 Susanna Adachi，一位瑜伽和冥想专家。
您可能不熟悉她的工作，但她获得了多个奖项。
Adachi 女士很高兴能分享她关于瑜伽如何改善生活的知识和见解与大家。
现在，在我们开始项目之前，请将您的瑜伽垫铺在面前。
